newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 0.55 percent in higher trade boosted by the bonds and over-the-counter markets, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 483,6 from 480.94 on Monday.
Volume was 3.94 million dinars against 1.33 million dinars. Turnover on the bonds market was 1.99 million dinars and one million dinars in over-the-counter exchanges.

Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing won 1.74 dinars to 30.74 dinars. Detergent firm SPCD gained 0.8 dinar to 27.8. Airliner Tunis Air rose 0.5 dinar to 19.5. Banque de l'Habitat edged up 0.56 dinar to 19.32 dinars.
STB bank fell 0.61 dinar to 19.79 dinars. Real estate firm SIMPAR eased 0.42 dinar to 24.1 dinars. ($= 1.07 dinars)
